title: 第11章 继续买买买
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
要买的东西还挺多。

    蔡老太问：“有没有蜂窝煤？”

    锅碗瓢盆啥的能自带，但蜂窝煤炉子没法捎带上啊。

    蜂窝炉子和灶台都安排上，那才有点正经过日子的样呢。

    魏建业抢先道：“没有，本地都是烧柴火，但是不能砍树，顶多砍点树枝，不过有野生牛屎可以捡。”

    婆媳俩都惊呆了，荒岛上居然有牛啊，从哪来的啊。

    服务社的女同志笑呵呵地念叨咋没有，“这边附属岛屿有十多个，都瞧见过野牛出没，听说是早年渔民带过来的。”

    这会也唠熟了，人主动道：“老太太，我和你儿媳妇差不多大的，以后叫我张福霞就行啦，坐着的是我儿子李长海，今年八岁。”

    那人有些热切地看着姐弟三个。

    此时三孩子正聚精会神的抠肚脐眼，察觉到大人们的视线后各种假动作掩饰，溜溜哒的跑走了。

    蔡老太心想这才是正常小孩啊。

    她第一眼瞅着李长海不太对劲。

    呆头呆脑的样子也就算了，眼珠子咋不对焦呢？

    内向的小孩也不少见，但眼前这个指定带点说法。

    不过这话只能憋心里头，她笑笑后顺势问：“那牙膏有没有。”

    张福霞弯腰去对应的抽屉拿，“还剩玉兰牙膏和黑人牙膏。”

    搁外头溜达的铁蛋听见了回头，“这名字好熟悉啊。”

    蔡老太说：“你妈就叫这名！”

    这会轮到芽芽震惊抬头，妈的名字难道不就是'妈'么！

    赵玉兰此时正忙着从肩膀上小布袋里掏啊掏，拿出来个卷起来的牙膏皮，“妈，在老家收拾的时候我瞧见了，正好带过来。”

    在老家用的是长白牌子的牙膏，这种牙膏皮子就算卖到收购站都有五分钱，比其他牌子的牙膏贵上两分钱，她可舍不得不要！

    拿来就用吧，蔡老太问张福霞：“这边也能兑换吧？”

    张福霞‘嗯呐’一声，都没觉得有啥不对。

    女人们操持家里头可不就是一点点节约起来的么。

    可边上的魏建业眼睛发胀。

    他没觉得亲妈和媳妇会持家过日子，只恨自己没本事，连个牙膏皮都得让婆媳俩千里迢迢地背过来。

    “妈，玉兰，你们先买着，我去跟渔民要点稻谷壳做枕头。”
content_en:
There are quite a lot of things to buy.

Mrs. Cai asked: "Are there any briquettes?"

You can bring your own pots and pans, but you can't bring your briquette stove.

The honeycomb stove and stove are all arranged, so it looks like life is passing by.

Wei Jianye was the first to say: "No, we burn firewood locally, but we can't cut down trees. We can only cut some branches, but there are wild cow dung that we can pick up."

Both mother-in-law and daughter-in-law were shocked. There were cows on the desert island. Where did they come from?

The female comrade at the service club laughed and muttered, "There are more than ten affiliated islands here, and bison have been seen on all of them. I heard that they were brought here by fishermen in the early years."

By now we were familiar with each other, and the person took the initiative and said, "Old lady, I'm about the same age as your daughter-in-law. Just call me Zhang Fuxia from now on. The person sitting here is my son Li Changhai, who is eight years old this year."

The man looked at the three siblings with some eagerness.

At this time, the three children were concentrating on picking their belly buttons. After noticing the adults' gaze, they made various fake moves to cover up and ran away.

Mrs. Cai thought to herself that this was a normal child.

At first glance, she felt something was wrong about Li Changhai.

Forget about the dull look, why are the eyes out of focus?

Introverted children are not uncommon, but this designation makes some sense.

But she could only keep these words in her heart. She smiled and asked, "Do you have any toothpaste?"

Zhang Fuxia bent down and went to the corresponding drawer to get it, "There are still Magnolia toothpaste and black toothpaste."

Tiedan, who was strolling outside, turned around when he heard it, "This name looks so familiar."

Mrs. Cai said: "That's what your mother is called!"

It was Yaya's turn to look up in shock. Isn't mom's name just 'Mom'?

Zhao Yulan was busy digging out the small cloth bag on her shoulder at this time, and took out a rolled-up toothpaste wrapper, "Mom, I saw it when I was cleaning up at home, and I just happened to bring it over."

In her hometown, she uses the Changbai brand of toothpaste. Even if she sells this kind of toothpaste at the purchasing station, it costs 5 cents, which is 2 cents more expensive than other brands of toothpaste. She has no choice but to have it!

Just bring it and use it. Mrs. Cai asked Zhang Fuxia: "Can I exchange it here?"

Zhang Fuxia said "hmm" and didn't feel anything was wrong.

Don't women just save a little bit when running the house?

But Wei Jianye's eyes were swollen next to him.

He didn't think that his biological mother and daughter-in-law could manage the household and live a good life. He only regretted that he was incompetent and had to carry even a piece of toothpaste all the way.

"Mom, Magnolia, you go ahead and buy some. I'll ask the fishermen for rice husks to make pillows."
